existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class contains attributes for a unique number, name, address, and city.
The ParkingLot class includes an attribute for the number of available spaces.
There is an association between Vehicle and Client, indicating each vehicle is linked to one client.
Attributes in the ParkingSession class capture start time and details of the vehicle.
ParkingSpace class includes an attribute that indicates the space size as small, medium, or large.
Conveyor class has an attribute for maximum vehicle weight capacity.
The model indicates that conveyor details are not needed at the end of parking sessions.
The PriceList class provides pricing details, including specific durations, associated per ParkingLot.
Client class includes attributes indicating club membership, showing client club management.
ParkingSession class has an attribute flagging free sessions due to club member benefits.
ParkingSession has a flag to mark sessions as free due to club registration benefits.
The AnnualSummaryReportService class includes operations for generating financial reports.
AnnualSummaryItem class captures parking lot details, total payments, and vehicle counts.
AnnualSummaryReportService sorts reports by city (descending) and amounts (ascending).
AnnualSummaryReportService supports output in both PDF and XML formats.
ClubGrowthItem class represents monthly new memberships and growth tracking.
ClubGrowthItem class captures monthly membership statistics and growth rates.
ClubGrowthItem is ordered by month to provide chronological growth tracking.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Administrator's role in updating parking lot details is not operationalized.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The domain guideline mentions an administrator updating parking lot details, but the model does not represent this role or operation.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Real-time vehicle data from gate sensor not operationalized.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The guidelines specify real-time data transmission from gate sensors to the system, but this process is not depicted in the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: System's instruction to gate sensor for barrier operation is missing.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Guidelines specify that the system instructs the gate sensor to open the barrier if the vehicle is found, which is not reflected in the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Absence of optimization algorithm execution for conveyor assignment.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: No representation of optimization algorithms mentioned in guiding documents, linked to conveyor assignment.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: SMS message sending with parking details is not included.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: The process of sending parking details via SMS is indicated by guidelines but not implemented in the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: End of parking session - vehicle handling by conveyors and request to external payment gateway.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Conveyors are to be used at the end of a session to transfer vehicles; also, requests to external payment gateways are omitted.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: System notifies gate opening post-payment approval.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Notification to open the gate after payment approval is part of the domain but missing in the model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Issuing of receipts upon client request is not modeled.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Although issuing receipts upon a client's request is mentioned, this feature appears absent in the current model.

uncovered_fragments.fragment: Preferred Parking Lots selection and storage not fully depicted.
uncovered_fragments.label: Domain Mistake
uncovered_fragments.reason: Guidelines mention clients can choose preferred lots, but selection and audit trail aspects are not fully modeled.
